camel_example: aliyun dms SearchAgenticDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken f056501ada120000 --CatalogUuid 'mc-HZ-OfjcNc2z000' --MaxResults 20 --SearchKey order --DbType MYSQL --EnvType product --version 2025-04-14 --method POST --force
description_en: Searches for databases across catalogs by keyword. You can filter the results by catalog, database type, and environment type. The results are paginated
description_zh: 跨 Catalog 按关键字搜索 Database，可按所属 Catalog、数据库类型和环境类型筛选，结果分页返回
kebab_example: aliyun dms search-agentic-database --search-key order --catalog-uuid mc-HZ-OfjcNc2z000 --db-type MYSQL --env-type product --next-token f056501ada120000 --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchAgenticDatabase

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. It matches the name, fully qualified name, and search name of the database, as well as the name or data source alias of the associated catalog
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键字，匹配 Database 的名称、全限定名、搜索名，以及所属 Catalog 的名称或数据源别名
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the catalog that limits the search scope. If you do not specify this parameter, the search is performed across all catalogs
parameters.help_zh: 限定搜索范围的 Catalog UUID。不传时在全部 Catalog 中搜索
parameters.name: catalog_uuid

parameters.help_en: The database type. This parameter filters the results exactly by the database type of the data source associated with the catalog. The value is the uppercase name of the database type, such as MYSQL
parameters.help_zh: 数据库类型，按所属 Catalog 关联数据源的数据库类型精确筛选。取值为大写的数据库类型名称，例如 MYSQL
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The environment type. This parameter filters the results exactly by the environment of the associated data source. Valid values: product, pre, dev, test, sit, uat, pet, and stag
parameters.help_zh: 环境类型，按所属数据源的环境精确筛选。取值：product、pre、dev、test、sit、uat、pet、stag
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. When you query the next page, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from the previous query
parameters.help_zh: 下一次查询的令牌（Token）。首次查询无需传入；翻页时传入上一次返回的 NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page
parameters.name: max_results

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned when a request exception occurs
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page in the current query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询的每页最大返回条数

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query. An empty value indicates that no more data is available. If the value is not empty, use it as the NextToken parameter in the next request to query the next page
NextToken.description_zh: 下一次查询的令牌（Token）。为空表示没有更多数据；不为空时，将该值作为下一次请求的 NextToken 继续翻页

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
